questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some dolls are rockets.

Some rockets are engines.

All engines are solids.

**Conclusions:**

I. No doll is solid.

II. No solid is an engine.

III. Some dolls are solid.

IV. No engine is a rocket.

options.text: Only conclusions II and IV follow.
Either conclusion II or III follows.
Only conclusions I and III follow.
Either conclusion I or III follows.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/453208aa0140893b5b64e67b0787ab749ce5a20aad58e6d7103ef43dd0f00945.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No doll is solid → False (As Some dolls are rockets and Some rockets are engines and All engines are solids so, No doll is solid is false) 

II. No solid is an engine → False (As All engines are solids so, No solid is an engine is false)

III. Some dolls are solid → False (As Some dolls are rockets and Some rockets are engines and All engines are solids so, Some dolls are solid is false)

IV. No engine is a rocket → False (As Some rockets are engines so, No engine is a rocket is false)

∴ Here, are **Conclusions I and III will form complementary pairs**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Either conclusion I or III follows".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

A set of two conclusions is said to be a **Complementary Pair** and thus form a case of **either or** when they follow the following conditions-

i) Both the objects must be the same in both conclusions.

ii) Both the conclusions must be False individually.

Some of the cases of complementary pairs are-

Some + No & All + Some Not 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] __Important Points__

questions.question:
Select the correct combination of mathematical signs that can sequentially replace the * signs and balance the given equation.

54 * 27 * 9 * 18 * 36 * 72
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36ef3af1935e65744670ee7ee42c5813e239516f166588cbbf93e7f1e9b6fb9c.png] 

Option 1) : +, ÷, ×, −, =

Given equation : 54 * 27 * 9 * 18 * 36 * 72

After inserting the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 54 + 27 ÷ 9 × 18 - 36 = 72

⇒ 54 + __**27 ÷ 9**__ × 18 - 36 = 72

⇒ 54 + __**3 × 18**__ - 36 = 72

⇒ __**54 + 54**__ - 36 = 72

⇒ __**108 - 36**__ = 72

⇒ **72 = 72**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 2) : −, +, ×, ÷, =

Given equation : 54 * 27 * 9 * 18 * 36 * 72

After inserting the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 54 - 27 + 9 × 18 ÷ 36 = 72

⇒ 54 - 27 + 9 × __**18 ÷ 36**__ = 72

⇒ 54 - 27 + __**9 × 0.5**__ = 72

⇒ __**54**__ - 27 __**+ 4.5**__ = 72

⇒ __**58.5 - 27**__ = 72

⇒ 31.5 ≠ 72

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : +, −, ×, ÷, =

Given equation : 54 * 27 * 9 * 18 * 36 * 72

After inserting the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 54 + 27 - 9 × 18 ÷ 36 = 72

⇒ 54 + 27 - 9 × __**18 ÷ 36**__ = 72

⇒ 54 + 27 - __**9 × 0.5**__ = 72

⇒ __**54 + 27**__ - 4.5 = 72

⇒ __**81 - 4.5**__ = 72

⇒ 76.5 ≠ 72

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : −, ×, +, ÷, =

Given equation : 54 * 27 * 9 * 18 * 36 * 72

After inserting the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 54 - 27 × 9 + 18 ÷ 36 = 72

⇒ 54 - 27 × 9 + __**18 ÷ 36**__ = 72

⇒ 54 - __**27 × 9**__ + 0.5 = 72

⇒ __**54**__ - 243 __**+ 0.5**__ = 72

⇒ __**54.5 - 243**__ = 72

⇒ - 188.5 ≠ 72

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"+, ÷, ×, −, =".**

• Sentence D states Edward's next speech which explains the one thing that the housekeeper needed to understand. Hence, D follows B.__
 
• Sentence **D **points out how even though Edward (and others) lived in a big house, it did not mean that they were rich.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given passage talks about flooding, its impacts, and its effects in India.
 
• In the **first** paragraph of the passage, it has been stated - *'Floods are not new to India and this sub-continent, but in recent years the problem has received much greater attention perhaps largely because it has led to much greater damage than in the past.' *
 
• Thus, we can conclude that the problem of floods has recently received attention because of "the severity of damage caused "by them lately.
 
• This makes option 1 the correct answer.
